text:
Maya (partnerships): Heads up — partner flagged 3 racks stuck at EU customs due to paperwork mismatch. This hits our Nov 15 joint announcement window if not cleared quickly. Need options and owners.
Liam (procurement): How many GPUs total? what's the capacity hit?
Sophie (logistics): Vendor reports 3 racks, 48 GPUs each = ~144 GPUs. Hold reason: MAWB vs serial list mismatch. Customs asking for per-serial manifest. ETA unknown until we provide documents.
Victor (cloud-sales): We promised dedicated capacity to two EU customers for that launch date. If this slips, we need an alternative or risk escalation.
Liam (procurement): APAC buffer currently has 2 racks earmarked for Q4. Moving them to EU would take ~10 days for transit + install.
Maya (partnerships): Options: (a) delay announce 2 weeks, (b) swap APAC buffer -> EU and backfill APAC, (c) do a limited availability announce calling out constrained EU capacity. Thoughts?
Sophie (logistics): I can push vendor for the serial export list today. Need partner export contact — Maya can you DM? Also can upload docs to our S3 staging once received.
Maya (partnerships): @Sophie sent DM with contact (anna@hardwareco). Uploaded current paperwork: s3://rw-inference/partner-exports/3051239999/docs.pdf — please confirm when you have it.
Liam (procurement): If vendor can't confirm by EOD tomorrow, recommend we trigger option (b) and open marketplace backfill PR immediately.
Victor (cloud-sales): Sales note — one of the two committed customers is EU-only and cannot accept APAC-hosted racks. For that customer we should prepare a temporary compensation offer (credits + extended SLA) if we can't deliver EU racks in time.
Sophie (logistics): Need approval for contingency spend if we must expedite. How much should I budget for credits + express shipping?
Liam (procurement): Rough estimate: credits + expedited shipping ~ $8k/rack. Approve up to $20k to cover two racks and administrative fees?
Maya (partnerships): Approve up to $20k for contingency. Action items: Sophie — get serial list + upload; Liam — open marketplace allotment PR as backup; Victor — draft comms for limited availability language. Reconvene 09:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: marketplace allotment PR opened by @Liam — PR #784 (automated).
Victor (cloud-sales): I'll draft a short customer advisory: "supply constrained in EU; limited availability for initial launch" rather than an outright delay. Keeps momentum.
Sophie (logistics): Update @team: vendor just uploaded the serial list at 05:25 UTC and I pushed to S3. Customs acknowledged receipt and says processing should finish within 48h if docs match. Will update if anything changes.
Maya (partnerships): Great — cancel the APAC swap for now. Keep the PR open as a hot backup. Thanks all, will loop CS if customs slips.
